description: Query Awwwards jury scores, palettes, and tech stacks from a local SQLite mirror - multi-filter search, trend deltas, and one-shot design briefings the site itself can't do.

tools.name: collections_get
tools.description: Fetch one curated collection's site grid (owner username + collection slug). Required: username, slug. Returns the html.

tools.name: collections_list
tools.description: List curated collections. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the html.

tools.name: directory_browse
tools.description: Browse the directory by one filter: specialty (freelance, agency-studio, art-direction, graphic-design, interactive) or country. Required: filter. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the html.

tools.name: directory_list
tools.description: List top agencies and freelancers. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the html.

tools.name: elements_browse
tools.description: Browse tagged screenshots of individual page sections by type: hero, footer, 404_page, about_us, animation, branding, contact, forms, gallery, header, icons, illustration, interaction, layout, loading, login_and_sign_up, maps. Required: type. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the html.

tools.name: sites_content
tools.description: Fetch the lightweight content partial for a site (same data, less page chrome). Required: slug. Returns the html.

tools.name: sites_get
tools.description: Fetch a site's detail page: overall + per-dimension scores, jury votes, color palette, tags, tech stack. Required: slug. Returns the html.

params.name: slug
params.description: Site slug from listing card data (e.g. monolog)

tools.name: websites_browse
tools.description: Browse websites by one filter: award tier (sites_of_the_day, sites_of_the_month, sites_of_the_year, nominees, honorable-mentions, developer-award), category (e-commerce, architecture), tag/tech (gsap, webflow, three-js, clean), country (france), color (%23FFFFFF), or font (Aeonik). Required: filter. Optional: page (default: 1). Returns the html.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter segment: award tier, category, tag, tech, country, URL-encoded hex color, or font name
